Runtime fuzz harness for block execution, vote and stake caches, leader schedule, and effects output.

# Purpose
This file implements a fuzzing entry point for Solana block execution in the runtime. It builds a block execution context from a test input, loads accounts into the account database, restores bank and epoch state, prepares vote account and stake delegation caches, and then executes the transactions in order against the runtime. The code also collects execution results such as error status, bank hash, capitalization, and cost tracker values, and writes them to the output buffer.

A second main task of the file is leader schedule generation and hashing for fuzz test effects. It builds an epoch leader schedule from stake weights, uses a fixed hash seed, and computes a canonical schedule hash from the sorted unique leader pubkeys and their mapped schedule positions. The file also contains helper functions for reading vote accounts and stake delegations from account state, refreshing vote cache stake values across epochs, and restoring sysvars and blockhash state so the fuzz target can reproduce block execution conditions.
